item.title: OpenAI Cuts Cursor After Musk Deal
item.description:
OpenAI Cuts Cursor After Musk Deal

OpenAI said Friday it will stop supplying its models to Cursor after SpaceX closed a $60 billion acquisition of the AI coding startup on Aug. 14. The proposed cutoff is Nov. 12, 2026, and OpenAI said it will not give Cursor future models. A vendor relationship that had looked, to Cursor’s customers, like ordinary plumbing is being reclassified as a risk the lab will not carry.
